subject: general
question:
Study the given graph showing the rainfall (in mm) in three cities, i.e. Delhi, Mumbai and Chennai from the year 2000 to 2003 and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f89d0773b8d51f9c33e4d3c4e88130510f101e32fbe69856d51343be600304be.png] 

What is the average rainfall in Mumbai?
solution:
**Given:**

Rainfall in Mumbai in the year 2000 (in mm) = 70 

Rainfall in Mumbai in the year 2001 (in mm) = 90 

Rainfall in Mumbai in the year 2002 (in mm) = 80 

Rainfall in Mumbai in the year 2003 (in mm) = 130

**Calculation:**

Total Rainfall in Mumbai in all the four year (2000, 2001, 2002, 2003) = 70 + 90 + 80 + 130

Total Rainfall in Mumbai in all the four year = 370 mm

Average rainfall in Mumbai = 370 / 4 = 92.5 mm

**∴ The average rainfall in Mumbai = 92.5 mm**
